[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Kathrin was born in 1659. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1149|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Laurimer-1|Eupham Laurimer]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1149]] is assessed at 49% (possible). Kathrin's 3 February 1659 St Cuthbert's index names Robert Glasgow and Euphame Laurimer. The full Lorimer couple ties this child to the recurring Edinburgh household, but no held kinship record links its adult father to the 1627 Inveresk child. The 1644 adult cordiner occurrence raises the same early-age issue.

Possible identification with Robert-1149 specifically; named record paternity is strong, while the Thomsone and Tailyour households remain separate.

Next useful test: Use the Lorimer family’s trade and property records to test the father’s earlier identity.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F318-KBC "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F318-KBC : 16 September 2021), Kathrin Glasgow, 1659.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
